rows.response_text: To lose weight and stay motivated, reassess your diet plan regularly as your body needs fewer calories as you lose weight. Incorporate physical activities, such as running, but make sure to switch up your routine to avoid boredom. Interact with supportive online communities for motivation. Write down your diet and workout goals to acknowledge the work you've put in and track your progress weekly instead of daily to account for daily weight fluctuations due to water retention.
